options.plan: Free; residency offer documented, account entitlement unverified
options.region: No Cloud region selected; storage destinations not verified
options.configuration: Native local users; Cloud-managed storage/logs/backups; no federation, customer export, SIEM or custom notification

conditions: Select ZITADEL Cloud Free with native local users, not the local self-hosted lab. The public offer lists EU, US, Switzerland and Australia residency choices: https://zitadel.com/pricing. No Cloud account, region or entitlement was inspected.

The service description defines a data location as a region that may contain multiple countries and separately excludes a transit-only regional guarantee. A regional label does not establish every at-rest country or prove all copies are covered.

The Cloud page advertises EU placement of user records, auth logs and cryptographic metadata: https://zitadel.com/zitadel-cloud. This is regional documentation, not an instance-specific inventory of countries, replicas, exports, logs and backups.

Review the selected instance, applicable terms and sub-processor destinations: https://zitadel.com/docs/legal/subprocessors. Customer-configured federation, exports, SIEM and notification destinations are outside this scope; provider-managed copies remain unverified. Coverage stays UNKNOWN with no countries.

evidence.summary: The Cloud service description separates hosting regions from transit limitations. No Free Cloud instance, complete destination inventory or country list has been verified.

conditions: The general secrets guide distinguishes database secrets, hashed passwords/client secrets and encrypted secrets, and separately identifies masterkey and TLS material outside Secrets Storage. It is architectural context, not a verified Cloud Free storage/key-management inventory.

Hashing, encryption, a passkey label or an egress IP address does not locate every credential copy. Do not infer country coverage, cryptographic configuration or key non-exportability from the general guide or AuthWeave's local ZITADEL setup.

Review provider-managed credential stores, replicas, backup copies and key material against the exact instance and terms. Customer federation, custom secret stores and notification integrations are not assessed; coverage remains UNKNOWN with empty countries. No credential retrieval, enrollment, key or configuration change occurred.

evidence.summary: The architecture guide describes distinct secret-storage mechanisms and external key material. It does not establish the deployed Free Cloud configuration or countries for all credential copies.

conditions: The streaming guide separates Events API resource-change events from Actions stdout and webhook/API output. Its environment table marks Actions stdout unavailable for Cloud, but that does not mean Cloud events or provider logs do not exist.

The support note distinguishes Cloud stdout access from subscription-dependent retrieval limits: https://help.zitadel.com/access-and-runtime-logs. The current public pricing page does not resolve this instance's exact retention or log destinations; no period, immutability or complete auditing guarantee is inferred.

Customer-side Events API pulls, webhooks and SIEM copies require their own destination evidence and are not configured here. Provider-managed event stores, log copies, retention and countries are unverified; coverage remains UNKNOWN with empty countries.

Region names and egress addresses are not storage-country evidence: https://zitadel.com/docs/guides/manage/cloud/egress. No live logs, Events API request, Action, webhook, collector, retention setting or paid integration was created or changed.

evidence.summary: The guide documents separate Cloud-compatible event/API paths and a Cloud stdout limitation. Actual event/log destinations and completeness are unverified, independently of audit-feature availability.

conditions: The service description assigns Cloud backup operations to ZITADEL and describes full/differential backups and recovery goals. Its displayed update date is April 5, 2024; these generic statements do not verify current Free entitlement, measured recovery, retention or storage countries.

Primary-region advertising is not an inventory of backup replicas, snapshots or all credential/log copies. Confirm provider-managed backup destinations and applicable instance-specific terms separately; coverage stays UNKNOWN with empty countries.

The guide mentions APIs for backup/restore/transfer alternatives; an API or export is not proof of complete disaster recovery. Customer export copies, external storage and their destinations are separate configurations, not inherited from a Cloud region.

No account, subscription, region selection, backup, export, restore, transfer, snapshot, cloud storage or paid service was created. Sources are dated mutable Cloud documentation, not a release pin or approval; ZITADEL/BFF, UI and the synthetic evaluator are unchanged.

evidence.summary: The dated service description describes provider-owned Cloud backup operations and generic recovery goals. Current Free terms, all backup countries and tested recovery coverage remain unverified.
